newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $109/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $109/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday were slow, with light reported sales of $108.00-$109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, down $2.00 from thin activity on Tuesday, USDA and market sources said.
About 700 head sold in the western part of the state, including live basis cattle at $66.00, steady to $1.00 lower compared with Tuesday's light sales.

The market was not established in the rest of the state, with packers bidding $108.00-$110.00 and owners asking $112.00 on a dressed basis. On a live basis, bids at $66.00 were countered by asking levels at $68.00, the sources said.
